field_changes.old:
Personal Records
Every exercise now has a Records tab showing your best lifts at every rep range, plus volume and session records. Break a record and Setgraph celebrates it the moment you log the set, and your day summary counts every record you set that day. Tap any record to see how it has progressed over time.

Share Cards
Turn any workout into a card worth sharing. Choose a design, customize its appearance and featured record, then save, copy, or share it anywhere. Take a screenshot in Setgraph and, when today's workout has data, its share cards are ready to go.
field_changes.new:
Exercise Illustrations
Every exercise in the library now comes with an illustration showing the start, middle, and end of the movement. Browse the library and you see the movement before you add it.
